title: the sign of % follows the dividend
purpose: Remainders use truncated division as in Go.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: language owner decision, 19.10.2026 (D-031): as in Go, x % y has the sign of x and |x % y| < |y| (truncated division): -7%3=-1, 7%-3=1, -7%-3=-1, 7%3=1, -6%3=0.
